title: The record tool does not count a figure-only doc nit against the review budget of a change that blocks every lane
why: A cap change that blocks every lane was parked after a figure nit in a doc used up its review records, so every lane waits for a rebuilt PR.
source: Coordinator 15:54 CST Nov 13: PR #3257 (Windows cap, parked); record tool refused more records after four records, a fix check FAIL and a round-1 FAIL on a figure nit in ci-job-caps.md.
note: Filed 15:54 CST Nov 13. Gap: the record tool counts a figure-only doc nit against the review budget of a cap change; the lane built no guard. The tool decision is pr-review-record (the record form and the done rules), so a lane reads it first and says whether a restart or a nit class is the fix. Overlaps: review-record-past-head, review-policy-as-data, record-after-each-round (check before a lane starts). A check change: test-author red case first, builder, reviewer. Past rulings not checked; the coordinator's read of #3257 is unread by triage.
